newsitem.title: USA: United Video buys stake in TV service.
newsitem.headline: United Video buys stake in TV service.

text.p: United Video Satellite Group said it agreed to acquire a 50 percent economic interest in Pelmorex Inc, a Canadian company that distributes multimedia weather information services.

Pelmorex operates The Weather Network and MeteoMedia, all-weather specialty television services in English and French, respectively, which are distributed to eight million cable subscribers, or 95 percent of the Canadian cable market.
United Video said it will invest about US$20 million to acquire the stake in Pelmorex, which includes a 29.9 percent voting interest in the company, the maximum allowed by Canadian law.

United Video and Pelmorex have agreed to joint venture future international expansion. United Video has the right to invest up to 40 percent in certain markets and 50 percent in the United States providing it with up to 75 percent economic ownership indirectly, the company said in a statement issued August 29.
The deal is expected to close in September. United Video said it will account for the investment under the equity method of accounting.
